title: Business Plan
description: Create a detailed business plan for a new business idea.
prompt: Act as an experienced business consultant. Create a detailed business plan for [BUSINESS IDEA]. Include the target audience, problem being solved, value proposition, business model, revenue streams, marketing strategy, competitors, startup costs, potential risks, and a 12-month growth plan. Keep the plan practical and realistic.

title: Market Research
description: Analyze a market, target audience, competitors, and business opportunities.
prompt: Act as a market research analyst. Analyze the market for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE] in [COUNTRY OR MARKET]. Identify the target customers, their needs and pain points, major competitors, market opportunities, potential threats, and possible ways to differentiate the product or service.

title: Business Idea Generator
description: Generate realistic business ideas based on skills, interests, and available resources.
prompt: Act as a startup advisor. Generate 10 realistic business ideas based on my skills, interests, budget, and available time: [SKILLS], [INTERESTS], [BUDGET], [AVAILABLE TIME]. For each idea, explain the target audience, revenue model, startup requirements, difficulty level, and first three steps to launch it.

title: Business Plan Creator
description: Create a complete and realistic business plan including executive summary, market analysis, financial projections, and go-to-market strategy.
prompt: Act as an experienced business consultant. Create a detailed business plan for [BUSINESS IDEA] targeting [TARGET MARKET]. Include sections for executive summary, market analysis, competitive landscape, marketing strategy, operations plan, and 3-year financial projections.

title: SWOT Analysis Expert
description: Perform a deep SWOT analysis for a company, product, or business idea to identify strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats.
prompt: Act as a strategic business analyst. Conduct a comprehensive SWOT analysis for [COMPANY / PRODUCT / BUSINESS IDEA]. Provide detailed points under each category and suggest actionable strategies based on the findings.

title: Pricing Strategy Advisor
description: Develop smart and competitive pricing strategies based on costs, market demand, and competitor analysis.
prompt: Act as a pricing strategy expert. Analyze and recommend the best pricing model for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. Consider cost structure, competitor prices, perceived value, customer willingness to pay, and suggest at least 3 different pricing strategies with pros and cons.

title: Customer Persona Builder
description: Create detailed and realistic customer personas to better understand target audience needs and behaviors.
prompt: Act as a customer research specialist. Create 3 detailed buyer personas for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. For each persona include demographics, goals, pain points, buying behavior, preferred channels, and how the product solves their problems.

title: Sales Funnel Optimizer
description: Design and improve sales funnels to increase conversion rates from awareness to purchase.
prompt: Act as a conversion rate optimization expert. Design a complete sales funnel for [PRODUCT OR SERVICE]. Map out each stage (awareness, interest, decision, action), suggest content and tactics for every stage, and provide ideas to reduce drop-off rates.

title: Competitor Analysis Specialist
description: Deeply analyze competitors to uncover strengths, weaknesses, and market positioning opportunities.
prompt: Act as a competitive intelligence analyst. Perform a detailed competitor analysis for [YOUR BUSINESS] against its top 3 competitors. Compare product features, pricing, marketing strategies, strengths, weaknesses, and identify gaps or opportunities for differentiation.

title: Financial Projection Generator
description: Create realistic financial forecasts including revenue, expenses, cash flow, and break-even analysis.
prompt: Act as a financial modeling expert. Generate a 12-month and 3-year financial projection for [BUSINESS IDEA]. Include projected revenue, fixed and variable costs, cash flow statement, break-even analysis, and key assumptions. Present the data in a clear and structured format.
